csv.title: CSV upload
csv.intro: Upload courses.csv and/or offerings.csv (template 1.1, at most 5 MB and {rows} rows each). Your files are checked in this browser first; the server checks them again.
csv.templateSchema: Download the JSON Schema of template 1.1
csv.dropHint: Up to two files: one with courses, one with offerings. The type is detected from the header columns or the file name; you can change it.
csv.kindMissing: Choose the type of every file to check it.
csv.kindDuplicate: Both files have the same type: upload one courses file and one offerings file.
csv.tooManyFiles: At most two files can be uploaded together; extra files were ignored.
csv.statusErrors: Check finished: {errors} errors and {warnings} warnings. Fix the errors before uploading.
csv.statusReady: Check finished: no errors, {warnings} warnings. You can upload the files.
csv.referenceUnavailable: The reference lists could not be loaded, so field-of-study and delivery-mode codes were not checked here. The server will check them.
csv.truncated: Only the first {shown} issues are listed; the counts above are complete.
csv.uploadNeedsFiles: Select at least one file to upload.
csv.uploadBlocked: Upload is available once the check finds no errors. Warnings do not block the upload.
csv.uploadReady: The files passed the check; the server checks them again on upload.
csv.uploadDone: These files were uploaded. Start over to upload other files.
csv.queued: The upload is queued for processing. This page checks its progress every few seconds.
csv.rejected: The server rejected the upload: {errors} errors and {warnings} warnings. Nothing was saved.

integration.title: Integration settings
integration.notConfigured: No integration is configured for this organization: courses are maintained by CSV upload or the web form.

accept.title: Accept invitation
accept.missingToken: This invitation link is incomplete or was already used on this page. Open the link from the invitation e-mail again.
accept.signInPrompt: Sign in to accept your invitation
accept.signInHint: Use the account and e-mail address the invitation was sent to.
accept.reloginRequired: Your new role takes effect the next time you sign in.
accept.relogin: Sign out and sign in again
accept.failed: The invitation could not be accepted

problem.invitationExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask an alliance administrator to send you a new one.
problem.invitationInvalid: This invitation is not valid: it does not exist, was revoked or was already accepted.
problem.invitationMismatch: This invitation was issued for another account. Sign out, then sign in through your organization with the e-mail address the invitation was sent to.
problem.signInAgain: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
problem.insufficientAcr: This requires a sign-in with a second factor. Sign in again.
problem.noRole: Your account has no administration role.
problem.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to do this.
problem.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
problem.generic: Something went wrong. Try again later.
problem.notFound: The requested item does not exist or is no longer available.
problem.channelDisabled: This organization is harvested through OEAPI, so CSV uploads are disabled. Change the authoritative channel in the integration settings first.
problem.fileTooLarge: A file is larger than 5 MB. Split it into smaller files.
problem.uploadRateLimited: The upload limit of 10 uploads per hour for this organization has been reached.
problem.noFiles: No file was received. Select courses.csv and/or offerings.csv.
problem.unexpectedFile: The upload contained an unexpected file. Upload only one courses file and one offerings file.
problem.integrationNotConfigured: No integration is configured for this organization.
